title: NovaJump
description: NovaJump is a highly-configurable plugin that launches players upward when they touch specific blocks like water, lava, or plates.
body:
# 🚀 NovaJump — The Ultimate Block Booster

**NovaJump** is a lightweight, modern, and highly-configurable motion management plugin designed for Paper and Purpur servers (version 1.21.11). It allows server administrators to turn any specific block type—such as water, lava, or pressure plates—into dynamic launchpads or environmental boosters with built-in server safety protections.

---

## 🔌 Features & Integrations

*   **Multi-Block Triggers:** Define which materials (e.g., `WATER`, `LAVA`, `OAK_PRESSURE_PLATE`) trigger the upward boost.
*   **Per-World Control:** Enable or disable the mechanic globally or limit it strictly to specific worlds.
*   **Smart Cooldowns:** Built-in configurable tick-based cooldowns per player to stop trigger spamming and maintain server stability.
*   **Velocity Safety Cap:** Hardcoded safeguards that prevent administrators from inputting dangerous velocity multipliers (e.g., millions) that could crash the server or trigger anti-cheats.

---

## 🛠️ Configuration & Setup

The plugin uses a straightforward `config.yml` structure. You can customize the physics power, set world blacklists/whitelists, and configure separate block profiles.

### 🛡️ Safety Limit Warning
> ⚠️ **Note:** The plugin includes an internal velocity cap (`MAX_ALLOWED_VELOCITY`). If a configured `boost_power` value exceeds this limit, NovaJump will automatically throttle it down to a safe value and log a warning in the console to protect your server's performance.

---

## 💻 Commands & Permissions

NovaJump features instant configuration reloading without needing to restart your Minecraft server.

### Administrative Commands
| Command | Description | Permission | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/jumpreload` | Reloads the config.yml file dynamically | `novajump.reload` | OP |

---

## ⚙️ For Administrators
*   **Paper Native:** Built using modern Paper API (Mojang mappings) for maximum performance and optimized block-collision checks.
*   **Developer Backed:** Created by b1gtorch as part of the Nova plugin suite.
